papers.title_en: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds
papers.authors: Zihao Liu, Xiaolong Shen, Zhenglin Zhou, Ruijie Quan, Yi Yang
papers.evidence: 利用视频扩散模型生成动态三维场景（4D），与三维运动合成相关
papers.tldr: 4D生成需从文本或图像合成动态3D场景，现有方法或重建RGB视频导致误差传播，或改造视频生成器导致依赖特定架构。我们提出Latent-to-4D，直接将视频模型的去噪潜在与预训练4D解码器对齐，通过帧级和全局时空注意力细化。仅用约1K重建片段训练，单个检查点可跨多个视频扩散Transformer。在Text4D-200和I4D-200上，相较同潜在线Wan+4RC级联，DINO-F1提升2.88-5.81点，且几何、时间稳定性和整体质量更受人类偏好。
papers.abstract_en: 4D generation synthesizes dynamic 3D scenes from conditions such as text or images. Existing methods either reconstruct generated RGB videos with a separate 4D model or adapt a particular video generator to predict geometry directly. The former suffers from distribution mismatch and error propagation, whereas the latter ties 4D prediction to a specific generator and may require retraining when the generator or conditioning regime changes. We ask whether the final denoised latents of video models that share a variational autoencoder (VAE) can instead provide a reusable interface to explicit 4D prediction. Building on this insight, we introduce direct latent-to-4D generation and instantiate it as Latent-to-4D, which bypasses RGB by aligning a video latent with the token grid of a pretrained 4D decoder and refining it through frame-wise and global spatiotemporal attention. Trained on roughly 1K existing reconstruction clips, a single checkpoint transfers unchanged across multiple video diffusion transformers within the same VAE family. On Text4D-200 and I4D-200, Latent-to-4D surpasses matched same-latent Wan+4RC cascades in projection-based DINO-F1 by 2.88--3.45 and 5.81 points, respectively, while also being preferred by human raters for geometry, temporal stability, and overall quality.

papers.title_en: FlowLOB: Efficient and Controllable Limit Order Book Generation with Flow Matching
papers.authors: Zhuohan Wang, Andreea Bacalum, Ollie Olby, Carmine Ventre, Namid Stillman
papers.evidence: 直接使用流匹配进行序列生成，可迁移到运动生成
papers.tldr: 现实场景中，限价订单簿模拟器需兼顾真实动态、高效采样、可控生成与跨标的泛化，但现有方法难以兼得。本文提出FlowLOB，基于条件流匹配生成订单簿轨迹，在港股多标的和不同采样频率上训练，支持零样本迁移。仅需10步ODE求解即可达到高质量，优于扩散模型及多种基线。同时通过分布检验验证了反事实可控性，并在架构和超参数上进行了消融。
papers.abstract_en: Limit order book (LOB) simulators are most useful to practitioners when they combine realistic market dynamics, computationally efficient sampling, controllable scenario generation, and the ability to generalize beyond the instruments seen during training---properties that existing agent-based and deep generative simulators provide only partially. We present \textbf{FlowLOB}, a conditional \textbf{flow}-matching generator of \textbf{LOB} trajectories, trained on multiple Hong Kong Exchange (HKEX) symbols at three sampling frequencies ($0.1$s, $1$s, $10$s) in tick-relative representation that transfers to unseen instruments. Because flow and diffusion models admit a common formulation, we train both with identical data, architecture, and budget, and sample both through the same fixed-step ODE solvers, yielding a controlled comparison of sampling efficiency and fidelity. Flow matching attains its best quality with only $10$ ODE-solver steps, whereas diffusion needs many more function evaluations to approach the same fidelity. At this efficient operating point, FlowLOB improves realism over baselines, two learned and two agent-based models, in most distributional metrics at the two finer sampling frequencies. We evaluate counterfactual controllability with a distributional test that asks whether changing a scenario condition moves the generated statistic toward the corresponding real tail regime; FlowLOB satisfies this criterion in most tested settings. Both realism and control effects transfer zero-shot on a held-out symbol. We additionally conduct ablation studies on the network architecture and the learning rate.
